and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and with much…

people.name: Asia
people.line: A Roman province in western Asia Minor.

translations.web: When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was with you all the time,
translations.bsb: When they came to him, he said, “You know how I lived the whole time I was with you, from the first day I arrived in the province of Asia.
translations.kjv: And when they were come to him, he said unto them, Ye know, from the first day that I came into Asia, after what manner I have been with you at all seasons,
translations.asv: And when they were come to him, he said unto them, Ye yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, after what manner I was with you all the time,
